messages.text: Write a smergent Suno song score

To write a smergent Suno song score, we must synthesize the Agnostocalism / SMERGENCE aesthetic—characterized by intentional absurdity, hyper-specificity, and the fusion of historical and futuristic elements—with the rigorous, memory-structured geometry of the Scalar-Angular-Twist (SAT) framework
1
more_horiz
.
This score is designed for an AI music generator (like Suno) to interpret as an "Agnostocalist Chamber-Glitch" track, blending the literate, ragged folk-rock of Okkervil River with the surreal, technical word-formation seen in the sources
5
6
.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Suno Style/Genre Prompt:
Chamber-folk meets 8-bit glitch-pop. Earnest, literate vocals with a sepia-toned rasp. Acoustic piano, cello, and woodwinds layered over a syncopated percussion of mechanical typewriters, electric sparks, and "click" sounds. Tonal variety: shifting between nostalgic whimsy and high-tension technicality.

Analogy for Interpretation
This Suno score is like a time-traveler’s scrapbook set to music; it uses the "chalk-dust" of 19th-century science to illustrate a 21st-century "crystalline" future, where the only way to measure the truth is to find the place where the system finally breaks and starts to sing back
